title: Netflix releases teaser for Song Hye-kyo and Gong Yoo’s period drama ‘Tantara’
summary: Song Hye-kyo and Gong Yoo's 'Tantara' is set to premiere on Netflix on Friday, December 11, with its 22 episodes divided into three parts.
